title: Report expiry policy
responsibility: Determines whether a report has reached its retention lifetime.

inputs.name: reportRetention.report
inputs.description: Report whose startedAt string is passed to Date.parse to get the start instant that reportLifetimeMs is added to; only startedAt is read, so other fields have no effect. startedAt must parse to a finite time, otherwise the call throws an Error.

inputs.name: reportRetention.now
inputs.description: Defaults to Date.now(), the current time in epoch milliseconds, when the argument is undefined; the value is compared with the start instant plus reportLifetimeMs. Any other value that is not a finite number, such as NaN, Infinity, null or a numeric string, makes the call throw an Error.

outputs.name: reportLifetimeMs
outputs.description: Retention lifetime in milliseconds, 30 days computed as 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 (2592000000); reportRetention adds it to the start instant to find the expiry instant. It is a fixed module constant, the same for every report.

outputs.name: reportCloudPrefixes
outputs.description: Array of three cloud storage key prefixes in this order: 'report-evidence/runs/' for report evidence, 'uploaded-screenshots/runs/' for uploaded screenshots and 'published-reports/' for published reports. Every prefix ends with a slash, and reportRetention does not read this list.

outputs.name: reportRetention
outputs.description: True once the start instant plus reportLifetimeMs is at or before now, meaning the report has reached its retention lifetime; false while the expiry instant is still after now. Invalid inputs make the call throw an Error instead of returning a value.

errors.name: InvalidReportRetentionTimestampError
errors.description: Error with the message 'Invalid report retention timestamp', thrown when Date.parse(report.startedAt) is not a finite number or when now is not a finite number.
